findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.gotcashback.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_portals, get_cashback_rates_by_store_id, get_gift_cards_by_store_id, get_portals_by_name, get_stores_by_country, get_my_alerts, get_gift_cards_by_store_name, get_my_profile, get_stores_by_name, get_portal_by_id, get_cashback_rates_by_store_name, get_best_deals_by_brand, get_best_deals_by_category · Public sink: get_my_profile · Destructive: get_stores_by_country, toggle_favorite_store, remove_store_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_portals, get_cashback_rates_by_store_id, get_gift_cards_by_store_id, get_portals_by_name, get_stores_by_country, get_my_alerts, get_gift_cards_by_store_name, get_my_profile, get_stores_by_name, get_portal_by_id, get_cashback_rates_by_store_name, get_best_deals_by_brand, get_best_deals_by_category · Public sink: get_my_profile · Destructive: get_stores_by_country, toggle_favorite_store, remove_store_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
